name: Registration creates a zero-balance account and gates dashboard access
description: Verifies an unauthenticated visitor must register or sign in before seeing account data, and a new account starts at zero.
steps: Choose Create account and submit valid new details
Confirm the dashboard opens and available balance is $0.00
Log out and confirm the login page is shown
expected: New account starts at $0.00 and the dashboard is not visible while logged out.

name: Member cannot add funds or manage accounts
description: Verifies ordinary members see the add-funds contact path rather than admin credit controls.
expected: The member sees customer support information and no form to credit balances.

name: Admin can credit member and freeze or block account
description: Verifies the admin management view exposes simulated credits and account status controls.
steps: Open Add Funds and credit a member
Open Members and freeze that member
Block the member and restore active status
expected: The member balance and status update in the local prototype and are visible in the account list.

name: Login rejects invalid credentials
description: Verifies invalid sign-in details do not open the dashboard on mobile.
steps: Open the login page on mobile
Enter an unknown username and password
expected: An error appears and the dashboard remains inaccessible.
